annotations.title: Extract Document Table to CSV / Markdown / JSON

description: Extract structured table rows (line items, transactions, headers, document metadata, summary totals, Markdown table, and CSV) from a PDF or image (invoice, bank statement, credit card statement, receipt, timesheet, or scanned table). Works immediately on the free tier (2 free documents/day) or with an optional Smart OCR API key.

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key from https://smartocr.dev (can also be sent via x-api-key header). If omitted, uses the free tier (2 free docs/day).

custom_headers.description: Optional list of custom column headers to extract (e.g., ["Date", "Description", "Amount", "Balance"]).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document content (raw base64 or data:...;base64,... URI). Provide either file_url or file_base64.

file_name.description: Optional filename with extension (e.g., "invoice.pdf", "statement.pdf", "receipt.png"). Defaults to "document.pdf".

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to a PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, or TIFF document to extract.

preset.description: Document preset: "invoice" for vendor invoices/bills, "bank_statement" for bank or credit card statements, "receipt" for retail/expense receipts, or "auto" to auto-detect.

name: extract_document_table
